 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Jayanandan Singh
 Oral Order
5 23-07-2014
This review application has been filed for review of the order dated 26.09.2012 passed in CWJC No.9242 of 2012.
The writ application was filed challenging the cancellation of licences of the petitioners for running meat shop.
The reason assigned in the order was that the meat shops were running in unhygienic condition with a bad upkeep causing danger to the health of the consumers.
This Court noticed the stand of the petitioners that they were ready to improve conditions of their shops to conform the requirements of law.

Hence, this Court disposed of the writ application with a direction to the respondents to allow the petitioners to run their shops provisionally for one month and renew their licences, if they satisfy the requirements of law in running their business.

Learned counsel for the review petitioner has referred to a joint report of the S.D.O and S.D.P.O.
dated 13.10.2012, as contained in Annexure-8, and the letter of the Collector to the Civil Surgeon dated 14.10.2012, as contained in Annexure-8/1.

He submits that apart from unhygienic condition,
all the writ petitioners were violating the provisions of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2011 also.
He submits that, as per the report, the running of the shops in thickly populated residential area was becoming a law and order problem for the administration.
This Court while disposing of the matter had observed that, if the petitioners satisfy the requirements of law in running their business, their licences be renewed.

Thus, enough liberty was granted by this Court to the respondents to refuse renewal of the lincences of the petitioners, if they found that the same was in violation of any law or causing any problem to the administration.
Hence, this review application was not required to be filed and the respondents were at liberty to pass a reasoned order in accordance with law refusing renewal of licences of the petitioners.
This review application is thus disposed of with the above clarification in respect of the orders passed by this Court.

(Jayanandan Singh, J) Arvind/-
